decisions.reason: Despite weaker recent visibility, this certified plate heat exchanger line is close to the core portfolio and can be carried with modest additional strain, so we would keep it unless performance clearly falls below aspiration.
Its earlier signal of major market share in marine water cooling puts it above aspiration and its fit with established marine capabilities makes withdrawal unlikely.

The marine cooling unit has limited public evidence after launch, but it still draws on existing marine cooling know-how and available organizational slack supports continued retention while learning continues.

As a more component-like offer with no clear positive performance signal after several years, it is more likely to sit below aspiration and we would reallocate resources to stronger core lines and new development.

Although technologically related to the firm's R&D path, the lack of visible traction suggests results may not justify continued dedicated attention, so we would redeploy resources to higher-priority products and projects.
